summary: HUD layout dispatcher: selects a speed-magnitude variant based on global byte_7D0474 (SpeedMagnitude when set, SpeedMagnitude_b950 otherwise), reads engine RPM via EngineRevValueAccessor, then dispatches to three HUD element renderers with the layout parameter a1 and per-element constants 20, 68 and 10: PositionOrderNameDisplay(rpm, a1, 20), UtilityFunction_b9a0(speed, a1, 68), and returns sub_4DB7F0(sub_49B7A0(&unk_7CE234), a1, 10).

operations.description: Guard on global byte_7D0474: when non-zero compute speed via SpeedMagnitude(), otherwise via SpeedMagnitude_b950().
Store the selected double speed magnitude as float v5 for the HUD element call.
v2 = EngineRevValueAccessor() retrieves the current engine RPM value for display.
PositionOrderNameDisplay(v2, a1, 20) renders the position/name HUD element at constant 20.
UtilityFunction_b9a0(v5, a1, 68) renders the speed-related HUD element at constant 68.
v3 = sub_49B7A0(&unk_7CE234) processes global unk_7CE234 (driver appearance flag) into a value for the final element.
Return sub_4DB7F0(v3, a1, 10), the final HUD element render at constant 10.

unresolved: Semantics of the per-call constants 20, 68 and 10 (interpreted as HUD Y positions by existing analysis, but not proven).
What global unk_7CE234 represents and what sub_49B7A0 computes from it.
Purpose of global byte_7D0474 in selecting the speed-magnitude variant.
